Package screen

package screen
The window and its screens: start menu and its settings, checkpoint map, controls, game screen and its pop-ups, camera.
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Backdrop
    Faint specks of dust far behind the level, in layers that scroll slower than the walls (parallax): they show the view moving even where the level is empty.
    Camera
    Follows the player's drop without pinning it to the middle of the screen: it aims between the drop's centre and its soft body, which trails behind, and further ahead the faster the drop goes, then glides there.
    ControlsEditor
    The table of key bindings, used by the controls screen and in game: choose an action and a column, then press the new key, or the new controller button in the « Manette » column.
    ControlsPanel
    The controls screen opened from the settings of the start menu: a ControlsEditor in a pop-up.
    Game
    Owns the window, the save, the controller, the music and the screens (menu, checkpoint map, controls or game), and switches between them.
    GamePanel
    The game screen: runs the game loop (about 60 frames a second), reads the keys, moves the camera, draws the world and the HUD, and shows the pop-ups for the pause, its settings, the controls, a newly learnt ability and the victory.
    Grid
    Coordinate grid drawn over the world in the px of a zone's plan, the coordinates its code uses: the lines turn and stretch with the plan, and every fifth line is labelled.
    MapPanel
    The checkpoint map: the whole world in small, with its checkpoints and lights.
    MenuPanel
    Start menu and settings: the content is rebuilt for each page.
    Popup
    Draws the solid pop-up windows of the game: a dimmed background, a window with a shadow, a title bar and a neon border, and small banners for short messages.
    Slider
    A menu button that sets a level from 0 to 100 %, drawn as a row of ten segments between its name and its value.
    Ui
    Shared look of the menus: colours, fonts, background and buttons.
